why_different_from_the_key: Pay is one monthly gross of 110000 (rate plus allowances) for 27 paid days, so allowances go with the 3 unpaid days: 110000 x 27 / 30 = 99000 (the key keeps allowances whole and gets 100000)

Overtime hourly rate is the whole monthly gross 110000 / 30 / 8 x 2 = 916.67 (rounded once) x 16 hours = 14666.72, taxed once on top of the annualised regular pay; the key uses the rate without allowances (13333.33) and annualises it
Each salary component is rounded once (36666.67 + 7333.33 + 7333.33 + 22000.00 = 73333.33); the key rounds basic pay and allowances as two lines (66666.67 + 6666.67 = 73333.34)
